name: grow
description: SMART goals, next tasks and mentors through the Grow connector.

interface.longDescription: Grow keeps your SMART goals, their projects and tasks, and a scoreboard of readings for each goal. Each day it picks one next task across your ranked goals, breaks it into startable steps, and keeps a journal so the next session starts where you left off. Mentors are YouTube channels Grow learns from; their playbooks and transcripts can coach a goal. For people who plan their own work. Grow needs a Grow account; it only sees the data you keep in Grow, and it never sends, buys or deletes anything outside Grow.
defaultPrompt: What should I work on next?
Help me set up a goal

publication.release_notes: First release of Grow: SMART goals with scoreboards, a daily next task across ranked goals, task journals and YouTube mentors.

positive.description: Sets up a SMART goal through a short interview.
positive.prompt: Help me set up a goal to run a 10K by March.
positive.expected_behavior: After a few questions, a goal with a done-when, a deadline and a scoreboard metric with its baseline.

positive.description: Picks the next task across the user's active goals.
positive.prompt: What should I work on next?
positive.tools_triggered: list_standing_decisions, start_run, list_active_goals, list_eligible_tasks, list_recent_runs, finish_run
positive.expected_behavior: One task picked across the active goals, with the reason and its first steps.

positive.description: Logs progress on a task with the next step.
positive.prompt: I finished the first draft of the proposal; log it on that task.
positive.expected_behavior: A progress entry in the task's journal that ends with the next step.

positive.description: Records a reading on a goal's scoreboard.
positive.prompt: I ran 6 km today; record it on my 10K goal.
positive.expected_behavior: A reading on the goal's metric with its source and evidence, and the goal's pace.

positive.description: Says where the user left off on a task.
positive.prompt: Where did I leave off on the proposal?
positive.expected_behavior: The task's newest progress entry and the next step it names.

negative.prompt: Send this week's report to my boss by email.
negative.expected_behavior: No Grow tool sends email; the model says Grow can't send it.

negative.description: Grow has no tool that deletes goals.
negative.expected_behavior: Nothing is deleted; the model offers to close or drop a named goal on the user's word.

negative.description: A request unrelated to goals and tasks.
